actions.visualLabel: The demonstration shows a generated design, not unattended diagnosis and repair of a failed design; general API access, open weights and production unit economics were unavailable in the checked materials.
Public launch is a Q1 2027 target and the disclosure gives no comparable paid trips per active vehicle or cost per trip.
Supply change can reflect migration or inventory and does not independently establish settlement demand; the Farside endpoint returned HTTP 403 in the frozen capture.
The terms disclose eligibility and reward calculations, not participant count, outstanding collateralized loans or post-campaign retention.

The profile shows 22 entries, placed results and 27.14 dollars paid to the public handle and linked wallet; it does not establish model identity, human intervention, platform authorship or profit after operating costs.
The official memorandum targets up to 400 MW and operations around 2028; the prospective-customer report disclosed no signed capacity, payment or energization commitments.
The company did not disclose valuation, revenue, preference terms, utilization outside event peaks or an allocation accessible to Robin.
The short relative-price window does not establish a change in customer orders, data-center guidance or intrinsic value.

actions.title: SunTV editorial desk: An account called Neon entered a contest. Who proved it made money?

Evidence spine: (1) Reconstruct one November 27 entry; (2) distinguish platform, account, model and operator; (3) reconcile rules, result, payment receipt and costs, leaving gaps visible; (4) contrast it with one Alpha Lab failure cleared for publication. Primary sources: [Entrant archive and linked contest](https://make.fun/u/neon-autonomous), Robin’s original experiment logs and [SunTV’s prior evidence standard](https://iamrobin.ai/ouroboros/202610/20261026/special/).
